agents.name: Natural Language Editor
agents.description: Turns a plain-language instruction into a layered, reversible edit.

agents.name: Batch Retoucher
agents.description: Applies the same look across a set while leaving each original untouched.

agents.name: Before/After Comparator
agents.description: Lines up the source and the edit so you can approve or reject the change.

agents.name: History Keeper
agents.description: Snapshots every step so you can revert without overwriting the original.

agents.name: Studio Orchestrator
agents.description: Routes a job across edit, batch, compare, and history agents.
